scope: Actual Mathlib elliptic group, all repeated-coordinate and two-torsion cases, discriminant b and actual quadratic coordinate lifts. Does not prove resultant recursion or general degree bounds, and does not claim the original Semaev PDF was read. Signed standing pending.
statement: On a nonsingular ordinary binary Weierstrass model over an algebraically closed field of characteristic two, (xy+xz+yz)^2+xyz+b vanishes exactly when actual affine elliptic points with those x coordinates sum to zero.
